description: Normalized workflow definitions sealed before use; scoped Venture governance links. No runtime authority activated.
statements: DO $$ BEGIN IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM operations.workflow_run) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'WORKFLOW_DEFINITION_BACKFILL_REQUIRED'; END IF; END $$

CREATE TABLE operations.workflow_definition (business_id uuid NOT NULL, workflow_version_id uuid PRIMARY KEY, name text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(name)<>''), owner_actor_id uuid NOT NULL, trigger_specification text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(trigger_specification)<>''), sla interval NOT NULL CHECK(sla>=interval '0 seconds'), expected_output text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(expected_output)<>''), exception_rules text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(exception_rules)<>''), retry_rules text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(retry_rules)<>''), rollback_rules text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(rollback_rules)<>''), completion_criteria text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(completion_criteria)<>''), status text NOT NULL REFERENCES operations.record_state(code), UNIQUE(business_id,workflow_version_id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,workflow_version_id) REFERENCES operations.workflow_version(business_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,owner_actor_id) REFERENCES core.actor_business(business_id,actor_id))

CREATE TABLE operations.workflow_step (business_id uuid NOT NULL, workflow_version_id uuid NOT NULL, step_number integer NOT NULL CHECK(step_number>0), specification text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(specification)<>''), PRIMARY KEY(workflow_version_id,step_number), UNIQUE(business_id,workflow_version_id,step_number), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,workflow_version_id) REFERENCES operations.workflow_version(business_id,id))

CREATE TABLE operations.workflow_definition_item (business_id uuid NOT NULL, workflow_version_id uuid NOT NULL, kind text NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('INPUT','DECISION_POINT','POLICY','APPROVAL','TOOL','KPI')), position integer NOT NULL CHECK(position>0), versioned_reference text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(versioned_reference)<>''), specification text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(specification)<>''), PRIMARY KEY(workflow_version_id,kind,position), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,workflow_version_id) REFERENCES operations.workflow_version(business_id,id))

CREATE TABLE operations.workflow_step_dependency (business_id uuid NOT NULL, workflow_version_id uuid NOT NULL, step_number integer NOT NULL, depends_on_step integer NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(workflow_version_id,step_number,depends_on_step), CHECK(step_number<>depends_on_step), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,workflow_version_id,step_number) REFERENCES operations.workflow_step(business_id,workflow_version_id,step_number), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,workflow_version_id,depends_on_step) REFERENCES operations.workflow_step(business_id,workflow_version_id,step_number))

CREATE TABLE operations.workflow_definition_seal (business_id uuid NOT NULL, workflow_version_id uuid PRIMARY KEY, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), created_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, UNIQUE(business_id,workflow_version_id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,workflow_version_id) REFERENCES operations.workflow_definition(business_id,workflow_version_id))
CREATE TRIGGER definition_guard BEFORE INSERT ON operations.workflow_definition FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION operations.guard_workflow_definition()
CREATE TRIGGER definition_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE OR TRUNCATE ON operations.workflow_definition FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.reject_history_mutation()
CREATE TRIGGER definition_history AFTER INSERT ON operations.workflow_definition FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.record_organization_relationship()
REVOKE ALL ON operations.workflow_definition FROM PUBLIC
CREATE TRIGGER definition_guard BEFORE INSERT ON operations.workflow_step FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION operations.guard_workflow_definition()
CREATE TRIGGER definition_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE OR TRUNCATE ON operations.workflow_step FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.reject_history_mutation()
CREATE TRIGGER definition_history AFTER INSERT ON operations.workflow_step FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.record_organization_relationship()
REVOKE ALL ON operations.workflow_step FROM PUBLIC
CREATE TRIGGER definition_guard BEFORE INSERT ON operations.workflow_definition_item FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION operations.guard_workflow_definition()
CREATE TRIGGER definition_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE OR TRUNCATE ON operations.workflow_definition_item FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.reject_history_mutation()

CREATE TRIGGER definition_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE OR TRUNCATE ON operations.workflow_definition_seal FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.reject_history_mutation()

ALTER TABLE operations.workflow_run ADD CONSTRAINT workflow_run_sealed_definition_fk FOREIGN KEY(business_id,workflow_version_id) REFERENCES operations.workflow_definition_seal(business_id,workflow_version_id)

CREATE TABLE governance.venture_assumption (business_id uuid NOT NULL, venture_id uuid NOT NULL, assumption_id uuid NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(venture_id,assumption_id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,venture_id) REFERENCES core.venture(business_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,assumption_id) REFERENCES governance.assumption(business_id,id))
CREATE TRIGGER relationship_history AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON governance.venture_assumption FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.record_organization_relationship()
CREATE TRIGGER relationship_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON governance.venture_assumption FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.reject_organization_truncate()
REVOKE ALL ON governance.venture_assumption FROM PUBLIC

CREATE TABLE governance.venture_risk (business_id uuid NOT NULL, venture_id uuid NOT NULL, risk_id uuid NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(venture_id,risk_id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,venture_id) REFERENCES core.venture(business_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,risk_id) REFERENCES governance.risk(business_id,id))
